//: Filled into every page by scripts/build-site.mjs. The build FAILS while legalName or jurisdiction is empty, so half-finished legal pages cannot reach the live site — same guard as config.js's API_BASE.
//legalName: Your full legal name. Paddle's domain review wants the sole trader's legal name in the Terms, not just a brand. Trading as 'Ad Interceptor' is fine alongside it.
//jurisdiction: Country (and state/province if relevant) whose law governs the Terms — where you are resident as a sole trader. e.g. 'India' or 'England and Wales'.
//paddleEnvironment: 'sandbox' or 'production'. Controls Paddle.Environment.set() on the pricing page. Switching to production is a deliberate release step, not a default.
//paddleClientToken: Client-side token. Public by design — it ships in page source. Sandbox tokens start test_, live ones live_. NOT the API key, which must never appear here.
//paddlePriceId: The $14.99/yr price. Live and sandbox have DIFFERENT price ids — swap this when switching environment.
//apiBase: Licence API origin, same value as config.js API_BASE. The success panel calls it to fetch the key by transaction id. Empty = checkout still works but the key must be issued by hand.
